author: Unity
description:
Learn how to use the official Multiplayer templates to build production-ready first-person and third-person games. 

Access the templates in the Unity Hub and explore the different technical architectures available; from high-performance Multiplayer FPS Template based on Netcode for Entities, to the modular Multiplayer Third Person Gameplay Template based on Netcode for GameObjects.

#Unity3D #GameDev #UnityTips #UnityLearn
title: Multiplayer templates on Unity
